RECRUITMENT NOTIFICATION
TECHNICAL ASSISTANT – DISTRICT CLIMATE CHANGE MISSION (DCCM) –
SIVAGANGA
Position Technical Assistant (Contract Basis)
Vacancy 01
Educational Qualification Candidates should possess an Undergraduate Degree in:
 Life Sciences
 Environmental Sciences
 Ecology
 Forestry
 Wildlife
 Public Policy
 Similar / allied fields
Desirable Qualification  Should possess basic typing skills in both Tamil and English.
 At least one year of work experience may be given first priority.
 Resident of the Sivagangai district.
Age Limit 40 or Below
Consolidated
Renumeration/Month
Rs. 22,000/-
Time Period 19 Months
Place of Work  Sivagangai District Collectorate and District Forest Office, Sivagangai.
Travel details:  Official travel connected with Department of Environment and Climate
Change activities, as per applicable Government norms.
Submission of
Application
 Applications shall be submitted by mail or in person through the District
Collectorate along with the application form.
 MAIL ID: cmgfp.svg@gmail.com
 ADDRESS: District Collectorate, A Section, 1st floor, District
Collectorate, Sivagangai.
 TIMINGS: (10:00 AM to 05:30 PM).
(Saturday and Sunday are Holiday)
Supporting Docments  Photocopies of 10th,12th and Ug Certificates, Government Issued Id Card,
Address Proof, Experience Certificate.
 Applicants should submit their application along with the required
supporting documents as specified in the official district recruitment
notification.
Last Date Of Application 15.10.2026 (THURSDAY) TILL 6 PM.
